cohort: 11,368 singleton, term (37-43 6/7 weeks of gestation) spontaneously laboring women delivering in 14 hospitals in Washington State between 2012 and 2014
finding: Early admission (less than 4 cm cervical dilation) is a risk factor for increased medical intervention and cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Early admission in labor (less than 4 cm cervical dilation) was associated with increased medical interventions, including cesarean delivery, for both nulliparous and multiparous women.
